blocks.text: 502 15015 VICTORIA AVENUE South Surrey White Rock White Rock V4B 1G2

parts.t: VICTORIA TERRACE resort style living with fabulous OCEAN VIEWS. Enjoy your morning coffee on the patio overlooking the Ocean & Gulf Islands.  Living area boasts a gas fireplace and sliders to the oversized and private patio. Great size master having a 4pc ensuite with jetted tub, spectacular ocean view from your master with a huge private brand new deck and BBQ pad. The complex offers a resort quality outdoor pool and hottub with southwest view. Walking distance to the beach, shops and great restaurants. A pleasure to show!!

blocks.text: Listed by Royal LePage Northstar Realty (S. Surrey)
